commander_specific_hypothesis: After Admiral Brass returns a Pirate with a finality counter, Power Conduit can remove that counter as the cost of its untimed tap ability; its +1/+1-counter mode adds a bonus counter. If that Pirate later dies, it can go back to the graveyard instead of being exiled and be targeted by Admiral again.

baseline_result: Baseline includes a 3-mana conditional instant/sorcery theft Pirate; Commander trigger itself does not require casting its target.
variant_result: Power Conduit can save a counter-marked returned Pirate and improve the Commander’s recurring engine; enables more repeatable use of many Pirate ETBs.

decision_reason_or_rejection_reason: Power Conduit directly interacts with the unique finality counter that limits the commander’s reanimation ability. The counter is removed as an activation cost; choosing the +1/+1 mode can add a +1/+1 counter when the ability resolves. Dire Fleet Daredevil offers first strike and an opponent-graveyard-dependent spell theft trigger, which is more conditional and less directly tied to the commander’s main engine.
reviewer_notes: Colorless artifact; no project exception. Current card reference explicitly lists it Commander-legal. Oracle verified 2026-10-13.
